title: World-R1: Reinforcing 3D Constraints for Video Generation
summary: A research project from Microsoft that improves 3D geometric consistency in text-to-video models using the Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning framework. It optimizes models like Wan 2.1 using feedback from 3D foundation models to prevent object warping and hallucinations during camera movement.
research_notes: Uses feedback from Depth Anything 3 and Qwen3-VL to reinforce 3D constraints during training.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026, World-R1 introduced a post-training reinforcement learning approach that requires no 3D assets. It achieved significant geometric consistency improvements (7-10 dB PSNR) over base models and was presented at ICML 2026.
